home.aboutTitle: A small place with a big table
home.aboutText: Ohrid Restaurant is a family-run restaurant serving simple, seasonal food. We cook with local produce, bake our own bread and welcome everyone like a guest at home.

home.visitText: Drop by for lunch, book dinner, or send us a message — we reply within one working day.

about.title: About us
about.subtitle: Family-run since 2009
about.storyP1: Ohrid Restaurant started as a small neighbourhood kitchen with six tables and one wood oven. Today we serve lunch and dinner every day, but the idea is the same: fresh ingredients, careful cooking and fair prices.
about.storyP2: We work with nearby farms, bake bread each morning and change the menu with the seasons. Children, grandparents and groups are all welcome.
about.value1Text: Short menu that changes with the market.
about.value3Text: Friendly staff, relaxed room, no rush.
